_: A second repository, to test the portability claim rather than assert it.
Audits samusmylove47-maker/eql-source. Kept here rather than there because findings go to
that repository's session through the Director, never into its tree by this one.
Pinned to 55832900 (claude/eq-map-export-proposal-oe8m6l), NOT main: gate.py is 431 lines
on main and 945 on that branch, so auditing main would audit a file about to be replaced.
Checks that damage a build INPUT carry a . Without it the repository's staleness
guard fires before the assertion and hides it — the MASKED verdict. The rebuild needs a
newer interpreter than the container default, which is a PATH question and not a limit:
puts a python3 -> python3.12 shim in front.
gate.py has NO __main__. `python3 scripts/gate.py` is silent and exits 0 — it does nothing.
It runs only through check.py:501 (`import gate; gate.run(...)`). An earlier version of this
file ran gate.py directly and reported UNPROVEN; that was a verdict about a command that
exercised no code. Every gate.py check below therefore runs check.py, and carries a `probe`
that renames gate.run — if the check stays green under that, the command is not reaching
gate.py and no other verdict about it means anything.
